title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy worker-src allows plaintext HTTP sources
description: The worker-src directive permits plaintext HTTP worker scripts, so the script that runs off the main thread can be supplied by anyone on the network path.
applicability: Responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit worker-src directive.
risk: A network attacker replaces the worker script and runs code with the page origin behind it, including access to fetch and IndexedDB; HIGH because the substituted script is executable code.
